native_priority._comment: GitHub native issue Priority field — now the SSOT (board P0/P1/P2 is deprecated, kept only for legacy reads). Keyed by native option name; p0/p1/p2 remain as back-compat aliases. Urgent = production block ONLY.

effort._comment: GitHub native issue Effort field (High/Medium/Low). LLM-estimated during triage, never asked of the reporter.

native_start_date._comment: GitHub native issue Start date (IFD). Dual-written alongside the board Start Date during native migration.

native_target_date._comment: GitHub native issue Target date (IFD). Native has no actual-end field, so the board End Date value is mirrored here as Target date.

priority_labels._comment: Board-less repos only: p0/p1/p2 map to labels, since there is no Priority field to set. Omit when the repo has a board.

_setup: Copy this file to config.json (gitignored) and fill in your own IDs. Per-repo overrides live in config.<owner>.<repo>.json, same directory, also gitignored. See references/field-ids.md for the discovery commands. No credentials needed: auth is your own `gh auth login`.
_boardless: A repo with no Projects v2 board and no native issue types needs only owner, repo, priority_labels and auto_labels; drop project_number, project_id, fields and types entirely. auto_labels MUST be [] unless the repo really has those labels, because gh rejects the whole `issue create` on one unknown label.
bot_marker: <!-- your-org-automated -->  # optional: string your issue-template-gate workflow greps for; omit to stamp nothing
